review.reviewer: independent PH-241 offset reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER 1 - a service-created Offset can violate the scheme-a clearance/offset mutual exclusion: create_offset computes advance_available = gross - active cleared - active offsets but never rejects a non-zero active clearance on the same advance cash; it therefore allows an offset on an advance that already has an active Clearance. That state is reachable through normal services because PH-232 can clear an unclassified cash and PH-239 can then classify it as advance (neither service checks the other invariant). verify_integrity's new offset branch then reports `clearance_offset_overlap` / `advance_cash_cleared` on a legitimate service-created row, i.e. the slice both accepts the write and declares it corrupt. Fix: reject offset creation when the advance cash has any active clearance (and add the matching advance-vs-clearance ordering guard in the PH-239 classification path or an explicitly coordinated small fix, since classification_services is outside this task's executor whitelist); add a regression covering the clear-then-classify-then-offset path so no legitimate state is a verify false positive.

BLOCKER 2 - offset availability and the offset verifier ignore the PH-240 refund/return coverage: create_offset's advance_available subtracts only cleared+offsets, and the verify offset branch checks only cleared+offset <= gross. PH-240 allows refunds/bank returns on any posted incoming cash (including an advance-classified one), so refund-then-offset can consume more than the posted gross (e.g., gross 53000, refund 30000, offset 30000 -> 60000) and both the service and verify_integrity accept it. The reverse order is protected because clearance_coverage_for_cash total now includes offsets and PH-240 refund coalesces it, but the refund-then-offset order is not. Fix: compute advance available as gross - active cleared - active refunded - active returned - active offsets using refund_coverage_for_cash(...)['total_cents'], and add the same clearance+offset+refund/return <= gross assertion to the verify offset branch, with a regression for refunded-then-offset rejection/cap.

BLOCKER 3 - the verify_integrity offset branch omits frozen-spec checks: it validates refs/org/project/advance cash state/classification/amounts/mutual exclusion/audit count, but it does not verify the advance cash effective counterparty equals the OpenItem counterparty (the frozen PH-241 spec requires 'advance 与 OpenItem 往来方一致'), does not check advance_ref.version against the cash version, and does not require the OpenItem status to be active. The service enforces the counterparty, but a direct-DB forged offset with a mismatched counterparty/version would pass the verifier, weakening the money-level integrity branch. Fix: add these checks (batch/prefetch as needed), and a forged-counterparty or wrong-version regression.

VERIFIED GOOD PARTS: Offset is an append-only settlement fact (model save/delete guards + SQLite/PostgreSQL migration 0005 triggers, same org/project as OpenItem, amount bound 1..1e12, status active); the service has company lock + open-item row lock, fresh role/module checks, owner/finance-only write, posted/in/advance-classified/effective-counterparty/same-counterparty/item active+receivable validation, period/lock/future checks, server-derived min(advance available, item remaining), SettlementReceipt idempotency (offset.create) with replay/changed-input conflict, dry_run with no writes, and zero half-write expectations; no ledger/accounting/SourceConsumption/canonical offset topic is written (generic audit only), Offset has no reversal; scheme a is implemented in PH-232 create_clearance/clearance candidates/remaining formulas and aging/clearance/open-item balances subtract offsets, and clearance_coverage_for_cash fills offset_cents; verify_integrity adds a scoped offset branch without global bans and the existing PH-239/240/250/253 branches still run; permissions/history-read/UI routes and module-disable write rejection are covered by HTTP tests; PH-232 spec unsynced is disclosed.
